_comment.baudrate: Serial baudrate. Recommended: 115200 for low latency
_comment.server_port: TCP server port to listen for Host sender. Recommended: 12345
_comment.block_local_input: Block local keyboard input (not implemented, always false). Reserved for future use
_comment.enable_logging: Enable debug logging. true = verbose logs, false = minimal
_comment.enable_hotkey_hook: Enable keyboard hook for End key hotkey. false = ZERO delay (recommended), true = enable End key toggle remapping (causes delay)
_comment.key_mapping: Key remapping for game customization. Format: {"original_key": "mapped_key"}. Use Arduino key names (e.g. 'rbracket', 'lbracket', 'space', 'enter'). Example: {"a": "rbracket", "w": "lbracket", "e": "p"}
